_comment: The IRIS capture for the worked example. FOUR files, and they are three DIFFERENT KINDS of thing that a single `uploads/` entry has never had to tell apart before. NAMING, corrected 2026-09-30: the CONTAINER filenames here are normalised stubs (`check:upload-names`, on the owner's ruling that downstream churn is accepted). The PATHS INSIDE the zip are not, and must not be: the saved `.html` references `./Publication and information products style guide_files/...` in its own markup, so the directory inside the archive keeps that spelling or the capture stops being reproducible. This comment previously said renaming `either half` breaks the pairing, which was wrong in the direction that matters — the pairing is between the html's MARKUP and the archive's INTERNAL directory, and neither is a file in a declared uploads graph, so `check:upload-names` never touches them. `who-iris/themes/themes.test.ts` holds the member path as `MEMBER`, separate from the zip's own name, so the two cannot be conflated again.

files.note: The saved DSpace item page. Its first line declares `saved from url=(0063)https://iris.who.int/items/18892cf3-5a4f-42a4-923c-a93f4a594dec`, which is the provenance — not an inference from the filename.

The page's sidecar assets. Carries `client-theme.css` (571 KB), `styles.e55b0c9926626404.css` (36 KB) and three SVG logos (`who_logo`, `who_logo_white`, `iris_logo`). These ARE the IRIS web theme; the rest of the zip is Angular bundles and is not theme material.
DSpace's 'Simple item page' / full record, in qualified Dublin Core. The authoritative metadata for this item and the worked example for `schemas/dublin-core.ts`.

The ITEM PAGE printed to PDF, 201 KB — NOT the publication. The publication itself is 2.68 MB and is `WPR-RDO-2020-003-eng.pdf`, listed below in this same intake since bean `yl5w` moved it here from `cat-harness/uploads/`; it is ingested as `library/wpr-rdo-2020-003-eng`. Recorded with role `none` rather than dropped: 'we looked at it and it is not what it appears to be' is a different fact from 'nobody looked'.

The PUBLICATION ITSELF — 2.68 MB, not to be confused with the 201 KB `…style guide.pdf` above, which is the item PAGE printed to PDF. The bytes `library/wpr-rdo-2020-003-eng` was derived from (its `structure.json` records this same sha256). Relocated here 2026-09-21 from `cat-harness/uploads/` (bean `yl5w`, issue #663): #477 moved `library/` into `who-iris/` and left the sources behind, so the catalogue's `localPath` claimed bytes that were one instance over. Recorded in this intake rather than only in the catalogue, because this file describes what is IN this directory.
